title: Portfolio - Feishu Notify Sibling
description: The portfolio's UNIFIED notification outlet, callable ONLY through the signed interaction-gateway (intent 'notify' -> Execute Workflow, in-process). One signed gateway request sends a Feishu group card, so no caller ever holds the Feishu webhook URL/secret. Build Notify Card is PURE (mirrors gateway-core normalizeNotifyInput + buildNotifyCard; differentially pinned offline); Send is env-gated exactly like the drift monitor's digest: unconfigured -> honest 'skipped', live error -> 'failed' (degrade, never crash, never a fabricated 'sent').
integrations: n8n Execute Workflow Trigger (passthrough) — invoked in-process by interaction-gateway (YKT4FJmC8Xg2G9hs) on intent 'notify'
Feishu custom-bot webhook (FEISHU_BOT_WEBHOOK_URL + optional FEISHU_BOT_SIGNING_SECRET from the runner env; never in tracked JSON)
buildMechanism: sdk-standalone (@n8n/workflow-sdk 0.15.1) compiled via scripts/lib/compile-sdk.mjs, deployed via the n8n public REST API. Must be ACTIVE/published in n8n 2.x for the gateway's Execute Workflow node to reference it.
notes: v0.1.0 — the unified notification outlet (P5). 4 nodes (sticky + executeWorkflowTrigger + 2 code). Level maps the card header colour (info=blue / warn=yellow / error=red); the footer note carries the gateway traceId for end-to-end correlation. The card build is differentially pinned against gateway-core.mjs by test-gateway-workflow.mjs; the send half is live-only and degrades honestly.
